english: Auspicious Mother
Empress of the Universe
Queen of the most glorious throne
The one who was born in the fire-pit of Pure Consciousness
Intent on fulfilling the wishes of the gods
Possessor of the radiance of a thousand rising suns
kannada: ಉದಯಿಸುವ ಸಾವಿರ ಸೂರ್ಯರ ಕಾಂತಿಯನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: Four-armed
Holding the rope of love in Her hand
kannada: ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ಸ್ವರೂಪವಾದ ಪಾಶವನ್ನು ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಡಿದಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: The one who shines, bearing the goad of anger
Holder of in Her hand a sugarcane bow that represents the mind
kannada: ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಪ್ರತೀಕವಾದ ಕಬ್ಬಿನ ಬಿಲ್ಲನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿದಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: Holder of the five subtle elements as arrows
The one who immerses the entire universe in the red efflugence of Her form
kannada: ತನ್ನ ಕೆಂಪಾದ ಕಾಂತಿಯ ಪ್ರವಾಹದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಮಸ್ತ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಾಂಡವನ್ನು ಮುಳುಗಿಸುವ ದೇವಿ

english: She whose hair has been adorned with flowers like campaka, ashoka, punnAga and saugandhika
kannada: ಚಂಪಕ, ಅಶೋಕ, ಪುನ್ನಾಗ ಮತ್ತು ಸುಗಂಧಿಕ ಪುಷ್ಪಗಳಿಂದ ಕೇಶಗಳನ್ನು ಅಲಂಕರಿಸಿಕೊಂಡ ದೇವಿ

english: Resplendent with a crown adorned with rows of kuruvinda gems
kannada: ಕುರುವಿಂದ ಮಣಿಗಳ ಸಾಲುಗಳಿಂದ ಹೊಳೆಯುವ ಕಿರೀಟವನ್ನು ಧರಿಸಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: She whose forehead shines like the crescent moon of the eighth night of the lunar half-month
kannada: ಶುಕ್ಲಪಕ್ಷದ ಅಷ್ಟಮಿಯ ಚಂದ್ರಕಲೆಯಂತೆ ಹೊಳೆಯುವ ಹಣೆಯನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: Wearing a musk mark on Her forehead which shines like the spot in the moon
kannada: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಕಳಂಕದಂತೆ ಕಾಣುವ ಕಸ್ತೂರಿ ತಿಲಕದಿಂದ ಹಣೆಯನ್ನು ಅಲಂಕರಿಸಿಕೊಂಡ ದೇವಿ

english: She whose eyebrows shine like the archways leading to the house of kAma, the god of love, which Her face resembles
kannada: ಮನ್ಮಥನ ಮಂಗಳಗೃಹದ ತೋರಣಗಳಂತೆ ಸುಂದರವಾದ ಹುಬ್ಬುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: She whose eyes possess the luster of the fish that move about in the stream of beauty flowing from Her face
kannada: ಮುಖಸೌಂದರ್ಯದ ಪ್ರವಾಹದಲ್ಲಿ ಈಜುವ ಮೀನುಗಳಂತೆ ಹೊಳೆಯುವ ಕಣ್ಣುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: Resplendent with a nose that has the beauty of a newly blossoming campaka flower
kannada: ಹೊಸದಾಗಿ ಅರಳಿದ ಚಂಪಕ ಹೂವಿನಂತೆ ಸುಂದರವಾದ ಮೂಗನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: The one who shines with a nose-ornament that excels the luster of a star
kannada: ನಕ್ಷತ್ರದ ಕಾಂತಿಯನ್ನೂ ಮೀರಿಸುವ ಮೂಗಿನ ಆಭರಣದಿಂದ ಪ್ರಕಾಶಿಸುವ ದೇವಿ

english: Captivating, wearing bunches of kadamba flowers as ear-ornaments
kannada: ಕದಂಬ ಪುಷ್ಪಗುಚ್ಛಗಳಿಂದ ಮಾಡಿದ ಕರ್ಣಾಭರಣಗಳನ್ನು ಧರಿಸಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: Wearing the sun and the moon as a pair of large earrings
She whose cheeks excel mirrors made of rubies in their beauty
kannada: ಮಾಣಿಕ್ಯದ ಕನ್ನಡಿಗಿಂತಲೂ ಸುಂದರವಾದ ಕೆನ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: She whose lips excel freshly cut coral and bimba fruit in their reflective splendor
kannada: ಹವಳ ಮತ್ತು ಬಿಂಬಫಲದ ಸೌಂದರ್ಯವನ್ನೂ ಮೀರಿಸುವ ತುಟಿಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: Possessor of radiant teeth which resemble the buds of pure knowledge
kannada: ಶುದ್ಧವಿದ್ಯೆಯ ಮೊಗ್ಗುಗಳಂತೆ ಪ್ರಕಾಶಿಸುವ ಎರಡು ಸಾಲು ಹಲ್ಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: Enjoying a camphor-laden betel roll, the fragrance of which is attracting people from all directions
kannada: ಕರ್ಪೂರಯುಕ್ತ ತಾಂಬೂಲದ ಸುಗಂಧದಿಂದ ದಿಕ್ಕುಗಳನ್ನೆಲ್ಲ ಆಕರ್ಷಿಸುವ ದೇವಿ

english: The one who excels even the veeNa of sarasvatI in the sweetness of Her speech
kannada: ಸರಸ್ವತಿಯ ವೀಣೆಯ ಮಾಧುರ್ಯವನ್ನೂ ಮೀರಿಸುವ ಮಾತಿನ ಸೊಬಗನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: The one who submerges even the mind of KAmesha(Lord shiva) in the radiance of Her smile
kannada: ತನ್ನ ಮಂದಹಾಸದ ಕಾಂತಿಯಿಂದ ಕಾಮೇಶ್ವರನ ಮನಸ್ಸನ್ನೂ ಮುಳುಗಿಸುವ ದೇವಿ

english: She whose chin cannot be compared to anything(it is beyond camporison because of its unparalleled beauty)
kannada: ಹೋಲಿಕೆಯೇ ಇಲ್ಲದ ಅಪೂರ್ವ ಸೌಂದರ್ಯದ ಗಲ್ಲವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: She whose neck is adorned with the marriage thread tied by KAmesha
kannada: ಕಾಮೇಶ್ವರನು ಕಟ್ಟಿದ ಮಂಗಳಸೂತ್ರದಿಂದ ಕಂಠವು ಶೋಭಿಸುವ ದೇವಿ

english: She whose arms are beautifully adorned with golden armlets
kannada: ಚಿನ್ನದ ತೋಳ್ಬಳೆಗಳಿಂದ ಅಲಂಕರಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟ ಸುಂದರ ಭುಜಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: She whose neck is resplendent with a gem-studded necklace with a locket made of pearl
kannada: ರತ್ನಹಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಮುತ್ತಿನ ಪದಕದಿಂದ ಕಂಠವು ಶೋಭಿಸುವ ದೇವಿ

english: Giver of Her breasts to KAmeshvara in return for the gem of love He bestows on Her
kannada: ಕಾಮೇಶ್ವರನ ಪ್ರೇಮರತ್ನಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರತಿಯಾಗಿ ತನ್ನ ಸ್ತನಗಳನ್ನು ಅರ್ಪಿಸುವ ದೇವಿ

english: She whose breasts are the fruits on the creeper of the fine hairline that starts in the depths of Her navel and spreads upwards
kannada: ನಾಭಿಯಿಂದ ಮೇಲೇಳುವ ರೋಮಲತೆಯ ಫಲಗಳಂತೆ ಸ್ತನಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: Possessor of a waist, the existence of which can only be inferred by the fact that the creeper of Her hairline springs from it
kannada: ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ ರೋಮಲತೆಯ ಆಧಾರದಿಂದ ಮಾತ್ರ ಊಹಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಸೊಂಟವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: She whose abdomen has three folds which form a belt to support Her waist from breaking under the weight of Her breasts
kannada: ಸ್ತನಗಳ ಭಾರದಿಂದ ಸೊಂಟವನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿದಿಟ್ಟಿರುವಂತೆ ಕಾಣುವ ಮೂರು ಹೊಟ್ಟೆಯ ಮಡಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: She whose hips are adorned with a garment as red as the rising sun, which is dyed with an extract from safflower (kusumbha) blossoms
kannada: ಉದಯಸೂರ್ಯನಂತೆ ಕೆಂಪಾದ ವಸ್ತ್ರದಿಂದ ಸೊಂಟವನ್ನು ಅಲಂಕರಿಸಿಕೊಂಡ ದೇವಿ

english: Adorned with a girdle which is decorated with many gem-studded bells
The beauty and softness of whose thighs are known only to kAmesha, Her husband
kannada: ತನ್ನ ತೊಡೆಗಳ ಸೌಂದರ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಮೃದುತ್ವವನ್ನು ಕಾಮೇಶ್ವರನೇ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ಅರಿತಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: She whose knees are like crowns shaped from the precious red jewel, mAnikya (a kind of ruby)
kannada: ಮಾಣಿಕ್ಯದ ಕಿರೀಟಗಳಂತೆ ಸುಂದರವಾದ ಮೊಣಕಾಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: She whose calves gleam like the jewel-covered quiver of the God of Love
kannada: ಮನ್ಮಥನ ರತ್ನಖಚಿತ ಬತ್ತಳಿಕೆಯಂತೆ ಹೊಳೆಯುವ ಕಾಲಿನ ಮೀನಖಂಡಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: She whose ankles are hidden
She whose feet have arches that rival the back of a tortoise in smooothness and beauty
kannada: ಆಮೆಯ ಬೆನ್ನಿನ ಮೃದುತ್ವ ಮತ್ತು ಸೌಂದರ್ಯವನ್ನೂ ಮೀರಿಸುವ ಪಾದದ ಮೇಲ್ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: She whose toenails give out such a radiance that all the darkness of ignorance is dispelled completely from those devotees who prostrate at…
kannada: ನಮಸ್ಕರಿಸುವ ಭಕ್ತರ ಅಜ್ಞಾನದ ಕತ್ತಲನ್ನು ತನ್ನ ಕಾಲ್ಬೆರಳ ಉಗುರುಗಳ ಕಾಂತಿಯಿಂದ ನಿವಾರಿಸುವ ದೇವಿ

english: She whose feet defeat lotus flowers in radiance
kannada: ಕಮಲಗಳ ಪ್ರಕಾಶವನ್ನೂ ಮೀರಿಸುವ ಪಾದಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: She whose auspicious lotus feet are adorned with gem-studded golden anklets that tinkle sweetly
kannada: ಮಧುರವಾಗಿ ನಾದಿಸುವ ರತ್ನಖಚಿತ ಚಿನ್ನದ ಗೆಜ್ಜೆಗಳಿಂದ ಪವಿತ್ರ ಪಾದಗಳು ಶೋಭಿಸುವ ದೇವಿ

english: She whose gait is as slow and gentle as that of a swan
kannada: ಹಂಸದಂತೆ ಮೃದುವಾಗಿ ಮತ್ತು ಗಂಭೀರವಾಗಿ ನಡೆಯುವ ದೇವಿ

english: Treasure-house of beauty
Entirely red in complexion
She whose body is worthy of worship
kannada: ಆರಾಧನೆಗೆ ಯೋಗ್ಯವಾದ ದಿವ್ಯ ಶರೀರವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: Resplendent with all types of ornaments
The one who sits in the lap of shiva, who is the conqueror of desire
kannada: ಕಾಮವನ್ನು ಜಯಿಸಿದ ಶಿವನ ತೊಡೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಆಸೀನಳಾದ ದೇವಿ

english: The one who bestows all that is auspicious
The one who keeps Her husband always under Her control
kannada: ತನ್ನ ಪತಿಯಾದ ಕಾಮೇಶ್ವರನನ್ನು ತನ್ನ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ವಶದಲ್ಲಿಟ್ಟಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: The one who sits on the middle peak of Mount Sumeru
Mistress of the most auspicious (or prosperous)
kannada: ಸಕಲ ಮಂಗಳ ಮತ್ತು ಐಶ್ವರ್ಯದ ಅಧೀಶ್ವರಿಯಾದ ದೇವಿ

english: The one who resides in a house built of the chintAmaNi
The one who sits on a seat made of five BrahmAs
The one who resides in the great lotus forest
The one who resides in the kadamba forest
The one who resides in the center of the ocean of nectar
She whose eyes awaken desire, or She who has beautiful eyes
Bestower of all wishes
She whose might is the subject of praise by multitudes of gods and sages
kannada: ಅನೇಕ ದೇವತೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಋಷಿಗಳು ಸ್ತುತಿಸುವ ಪರಾಕ್ರಮವುಳ್ಳ ದೇವಿ

english: Endowed with an army of shaktis intent on slaying bhaNDAsura
kannada: ಭಂಡಾಸುರನ ಸಂಹಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಸನ್ನದ್ಧವಾದ ಶಕ್ತಿಸೇನೆಯಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿರುವ ದೇವಿ

english: Who is attended by a herd of elephants ably commanded by sampatkarI
Surrounded by a cavalry of several million horses which are under the command of the shakti, ashvArUDhA
kannada: ಅಶ್ವಾರೂಢಾ ಶಕ್ತಿಯ ನೇತೃತ್ವದ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಕುದುರೆಗಳ ಸೇನೆಯಿಂದ ಸುತ್ತುವರಿದ ದೇವಿ

english: The one who shines in Her chariot chakrarAja, equipped with all kinds of weapons
kannada: ಎಲ್ಲ ವಿಧದ ಆಯುಧಗಳಿಂದ ಸಜ್ಜಿತವಾದ ಚಕ್ರರಾಜ ರಥದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಕಾಶಿಸುವ ದೇವಿ

english: Served by the shakti named mantriNI who rides the chariot known as geyacakra
kannada: ಗೇಯಚಕ್ರ ರಥದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಮಂತ್ರಿಣೀ ಶಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ಸೇವಿಸಲ್ಪಡುವ ದೇವಿ

english: Escorted by the shakti known as daNDanAthA, seated in the kirichakra chariot
kannada: ಕಿರಿಚಕ್ರ ರಥದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ದಂಡನಾಥಾ ಶಕ್ತಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಾಗುವ ದೇವಿ

english: Possessor of taken position at the center of the fortress of fire created by the goddess, jvAlAmAlinI
The one who rejoices at the valor of the shaktis who are intent on destroying the forces of bhaNDAsura
The one who delights in seeing the might and the pride of Her nityA deities
The one who delights in seeing the valor of the goddess bAla who is intent on killing the sons of bhaNDa
The one who rejoices at the destruction, in battle, of the demon viShanga by the mantriNI shakti
Pleased with the prowess of vArAhI who took the life of vishukra
Giver of rise to gaNesha by a glance at the face of kAmeshvara
The one who rejoices when gaNesha shatters all obstacles
The one who showers counter weapons to each weapon fired at Her by bhaNDAsura
The one who created from Her fingernails all ten incarnations of NArAyaNa (viShNu)
The one who burned the armies of the demons in the fire of the missile, mahApAshupata
The one who burned and destroyed bhaNDAsura and his capital shUnyaka with the kAmeshvara missle
She whose many powers are extolled by brahmA, viShNu, shiva and other gods
The one who became the life-giving medicine for kAmadeva (the god of love) who had been burned to ashes by the fire from shiva's (third) eye
She whose lotus face is the auspicious vAgbhavakUTa (a group of syllables of the panchadashi mantra)
The one who from Her neck to Her waist is of the form of the madhyakUTa (the middle six syllables of the panchadashAkShari mantra)
She whose form below the waist is the shaktikUTa (the last four syllables of the pancadashAkShari mantra)
Embodiment of the mUla mantra (the pancadashAkShari mantra)
She whose (subtle) body is made of the three parts of the pancadashAkShari mantra
Especially fond of the nectar known as kula
Protector of the code of rituals of the path of yoga known as kula
Well-born (who is from a good family)
The one who resides in the kula vidyA
The one who belongs to the kula
Deity in the kulas
The one who does not have a family
The one who resides inside 'samaya'
Attached to the samaya form of worship
She whose principal abode is the mUlAdhAra
The one who breaks through the knot of brahma
The one who emerges in the maNipUra cakra
The one who breaks through the knot of viShNu
The one who resides at the center of the Aj~nA chakra
The one who breaks through the knot of shiva
The one who ascends to the thousand-petaled lotus
The one who pours out streams of ambrosia
As beautiful as a flash of lightning
The one who resides above the six chakrAs
Greatly attached to the festive union of shiva and shakti
Possessor of the form a coil
Fine and delicate as the fiber of the lotus
Wife of bhava (shiva)
Unattainable through imagination or thought
Like an axe to clear the jungle of samsAra
Fond of all auspicious things - who gives all auspicious things
Embodiment of auspiciousness or benevolence
The one who confers prosperity on Her devotees
Fond of (and pleased by) devotion
Attained only through devotion
To be won over by devition
Dispeller of fear
Wife of shambhu (shiva)
Worshipped by sharadA (sarasvatI, the goddess of speech)
Wife of sharva (shiva)
The one who confers happiness
Giver of happiness
The one who bestows riches in abundance
Chaste
She whose face shines like the full moon in the clear autumn sky
Slender-waister
Peaceful
Without dependence
The one who stays unattached, bound to nothing
Free from all impurities arising from action
Free from all impurities
Eternal
Without form
Without agitation
Beyond all three gunas of nature, namely sattva, rajas and tamas
Without parts
Tranquil
Without desire
Indestructible
Ever free from worldly bonds
Unchanging
Not of this universe
The one who does not depend on anything
Eternally pure
Ever wise
Blameless or She who is praiseworthy
All-pervading
Without cause
Faultless
Not conditioned or has no limitations
Possessor of no superior or protector
Possessor of no desire
Destroyer of desires (passions)
Without pride
Destroyer of pride
Possessor of no anxiety in anything
Without egoism.
Free from delusion
Destroyer of delusion in Her devotees
Possessor of no self-interest in anything
Destroyer of the sense of ownership
Without sin
Destroyer of all the sins of Her devotees niShkrodhA
Without anger
Destroyer of anger in Her devotees
Without greed
Destroyer of greed in Her devotees
Without doubts
The one who kills all doubts
Without origin
Destroyer of the sorrow of samsAra (the cycle of birth and death)
Free of false imaginings
Not disturbed by anything
Beyond all sense of difference
Remover of from Her devotees all sense of differences born of vAsanAs
Imperishable
Destroyer of death
The one who remains without action
The one who does not acquire or accept anything
Incomparable, unequalled
Possessor of shining black hair
Imperishable
The one who cannot be transgressed
Won only with much difficulty
Approachable only with extreme effort
Goddess DurgA
Destroyer of sorrow
Giver of happiness
Unapproachable by sinners
The one who stops evil customs
Free from all faults
Omniscient
The one who shows intense compassion
Possessor of neither equal nor superior
Possessor of all the divine powers (she who is omnipotent)
Source of all that is auspicious
The one who leads into the right path
